name: One Dark & One Light
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: A coder's favourite for writing: One Light by day and One Dark at night, blue links, headings stepping through purple, blue, green and gold, and code in the same colours. On the Atom One palettes.

zh.description: 写代码的人最爱的写作配色：白天 One Light，夜里 One Dark，蓝色链接，标题依次为紫、蓝、绿、金，代码也用同一套颜色。基于 Atom One 配色。
